name: Second Wind
description: You can draw on your stamina to heal yourself. As a Bonus Action, regain HP equal to 1d10 + your Fighter level. You can use this twice. You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest, and all of them when you finish a Long Rest.

name: Action Surge
description: On your turn, take one additional action, except the Magic action. Regain this use after a Short or Long Rest.

name: Superiority Die
description: Spend this d8 to use a known maneuver. All four dice return after either kind of rest. A single attack can use only one maneuver.
